comment_regular: Verified: this is a TESRoad method; the TravelPath caller obtains it from TESWorldSpace+0x54. Searches the road's per-cell connected-point map starting at the endpoint's cell, expands through neighboring cell buckets, and returns a nearest point from the first populated ring (bounded by 20 expansion steps). dbl_A3A5B0 is only an FLT_MAX sentinel. The separate fRoadPointReachDistance setting (default 500) is not used as this search's threshold.
